slips: keys need quotes but box names don't ({name: "Lucky"} crashes with NameError); key spelling/case ("Max_Mana" vs "max_mana") gives KeyError; skipping a nesting level (hero["wisdom"] instead of hero["abilities"]["wisdom"]); quoting a variable key (book["spell_name"] instead of book[spell_name]); typing literal numbers instead of reading/writing by key (CMB: hero["mana"] = 7 instead of hero["mana"] - cost); `in` checks keys not values (2 in book is False even when 2 is a value); dot access (hero.mana) instead of brackets; round brackets hero("mana"); indexing a dict by position (hero[0]); roster["Gearshift"] instead of roster[1]["name"]; missing comma or colon in a dict literal; using = inside a dict literal instead of :.
earlierNote: Units 1-2 are shipped and Unit 3 (Functions I: def, parameters, return) is verified; all three are in this folder. Unit 4 (Lists) is being written AT THE SAME TIME in another staging dir and is NOT in this folder. Its concepts come from concept_map.json (prefixes u04a, u04b, u04c). Unit 5 may use lists ONLY within those planned concepts (list literals, indexing incl. -1, len, append, a list of dicts read by index). Use the real party-table values for the heroes' stat sheets.
verifyNote: Fix every Unit 5 error until 0 errors; with concept_map.json moved aside the u04 concepts are missing, so for errors that are ONLY 'concept not introduced yet' for tokens the plan gives to u04a/u04b/u04c, restore the map and re-run with it instead, and report those tokens (they get cross-checked when Unit 4 ships).
extra: Campaign callbacks: spell-book (Obj 1, 8), mana-bars and hold-the-barrier (the mana subtraction, Obj 2-3; hold-the-barrier's body for Obj 9), `if spell_name not in caster["spell_book"]:` (Obj 4), caster["abilities"]["magical_affinity"] (Obj 6), party.members (Obj 7).
